# lago Provider

Lago API provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "triton-one/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_endpoint` (String) Lago API endpoint (for example `https://api.getlago.com/api/v1`). Can also be set with `LAGO_API_ENDPOINT`.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Lago API key. Can also be set with `LAGO_API_KEY`.
